signals.derivation: Prisma schema contains Patient and MedicalRecord models. NHS numbers, names, DOBs, and diagnoses are stored. GDPR Art. 9 special category health data. UK GDPR applies post-Brexit.
NHS data retention requirements apply (10 years for adult patient records). GDPR Art. 17 right to erasure must be balanced against NHS retention obligations.
jsonwebtoken used for authentication. JWT_SECRET in .env.example. Stateless auth pattern. No evidence of PHI in JWT payload from source scan.
